_note: open-edit 自建 DoP 相机预设库（对标 Higgsfield DoP）。模型无关：每个预设是一段可注入任意 i2v/t2v prompt 的镜头语言宏。来源 = Higgsfield 官方 camera-controls 66 预设 + GitHub camera skill 运镜含义表（MIT）。研究见 _research/higgsfield-2026-06-28/04。
_usage: engine/prompt_kit.py 的 MCSLA C 层从这里取 prompt_fragment；导演大脑按情绪用 emotion_sync 选预设。

rules.sequential_vs_simultaneous: 同时=两运动并发；顺序=带时间戳分段（'pans left 0-3s ... then pushes in 4-8s'）
rules.double_contrast_cut: 每个 cut 必须同时改变景别 AND 相机性格
rules.face_safe_default: 人物特写/中景默认用克制运镜（slow dolly / static + 微动），避免大环绕/快甩（会崩脸+漂场景）

emotion_sync._note: 镜头=焦点角色情绪的替身。导演大脑按这张表给情绪选运镜处方。
emotion_sync.anger_tension: Handheld breathing, jittery and unstable, choppy breath rhythm, small irregular two-axis micro-jitter. Avoid stabilizer.
emotion_sync.calm_control: Handheld breathing, smooth, steady breath rate, regular micro-amplitude. Lightly stabilized but still alive.
emotion_sync.sadness_vulnerable: Handheld, slow, low; lower breath frequency, slight downward drift, heavier operator weight.
emotion_sync.shock_reveal: Static + very slow push-in or pull-out; sharp freeze at the reveal, then 0.5-2s of minimal movement.
emotion_sync.action: 60fps, 180-degree shutter; clean kinetics with shutter-locked motion blur.
emotion_sync.finale_verdict: Top-shot freeze, 0.3-0.5s; directly overhead, time stops, all positions locked.
emotion_sync.breakdown_needs_space: Slow pull from medium/close to wide — leave the character alone; visual distance = emotional space.
